readerCopy.body:
You can talk a little further ahead of the information than usual. The plan sounds obvious. The deadline feels generous. The paragraph you skim is the one that changes the agreement. You may promise more than the calendar can hold because the whole idea makes sense in your head.

Jupiter square Mercury makes everything sound convincing, including the mistakes. Before you sign, send, book, or announce, read the part you are bored of. Check the date, price, scope, and person responsible for the next step. A big plan may still work. It will work better with the right facts underneath it.
